_about: Design summaries of U.S. weather stations, keyed by WMO station number. Built by tools/build_weather_stations.py from EPW files fetched by tools/download_tmy3_epw.py. Any other location can be used by loading its EPW file in the app or by entering design_conditions in the house file.
_source: EnergyPlus weather data collection, U.S. Department of Energy / NREL (https://energyplus.net/weather; file index: weather/master.geojson in the EnergyPlus repository). TMY3 files: NREL typical meteorological year data, 1991-2005 (Wilcox and Marion, Users Manual for TMY3 Data Sets, NREL/TP-581-43156, 2008).
